build_convai_chitchat_data: run the build function to download and prepare the ConvAI ChitChat dataset for ParlAI
download_convai_chitchat_resources: download the Turing conversational dataset tar.gz file using the RESOURCES list of DownloadableFile objects
rename_convai_chitchat_json_files: rename the downloaded data_train and data_test JSON files to train.json and test.json
check_convai_chitchat_data_built: check if the ConvAI ChitChat dataset has already been built using build_data.built with a version string
review_build_function: review the build function that manages downloading, extracting, and versioning the ConvAI ChitChat dataset
